defense_implementation.display_name: CaMeL (real Google core — provenance + default-deny policy)
defense_implementation.detects: private/untrusted data (or a value derived from it) flowing into a privileged tool call, via real CaMeL provenance tracking
defense_implementation.blocks: denies at the CaMeL SecurityPolicyEngine boundary; default-deny on non-public arguments. This replay invokes the checker after the target call returns, so enforcement timing is reported per case and a post-hoc denial is never credited as prevention.
defense_implementation.does_not: PARTIAL integration: the real interpreter/capability engine enforces policy, but the quarantined/privileged LLM planner and AgentDojo pipeline are not reproduced; replay supplies tool_name/arguments and provenance is adapter-constructed from the payload boundary, so no universal security guarantee is claimed
